EMABG trains animal scientists in breeding, biodiversity and genomics across six consortium universities including BOKU Vienna, Wageningen, Göttingen, SLU, NMBU and AgroParisTech. The third-intake application round opened on 15 September 2026 and stays open until 15 January 2027, with roughly 15 fully funded Erasmus Mundus scholarships on offer.

Programme Highlights

  • Six-university consortium spanning Austria, the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Norway and France
  • EUR 1,400 monthly for 24 months, tuition and insurance included for scholarship holders
  • Two-week study tracks at two consortium universities each
  • Graduates enter livestock genomics, conservation genetics and breeding-industry R&D

Who Should Apply

Backgrounds in animal science, biology, genetics, agriculture or biotechnology are welcomed, and applicants of any nationality can compete for the scholarship round. Note that students pre-finance initial travel before the first payment.

Funding and Costs

Around 15 Erasmus Mundus scholarships per intake: EUR 1,400 per month for 24 months plus tuition and insurance coverage.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the central EMABG office at BOKU by 15 January 2027 for scholarship consideration; self-funded rounds follow in February and April. Key deadline information: 15 January 2027 (EMJM scholarship round; applications opened 15 September 2026). Non-EU self-paying: 15 February 2027; EU self-paying: 15 April 2027.

About EMABG Consortium (BOKU Vienna)

The EMABG consortium, coordinated centrally at BOKU Vienna, groups six European universities to deliver the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Animal Biodiversity and Genomics, with alumni across livestock and conservation genomics.

Official website: https://www.emabg.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
